title: Built a trading strategy system looking for honest feedback
author: Silent_Mango_4703
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’ve been working on a strategy system based on a specific set of rules and conditions, and I’m looking for a few traders to test it and give me honest feedback.

I’m offering a 7-day free trial so you can actually test it yourself instead of just taking my word for it.

You can test it on:

Prop firm accounts

Live accounts

Demo accounts

I’m especially interested in feedback from traders who are experienced with prop firms or live trading.

I’m not claiming it’s a “holy grail” or guaranteed profitable system. I’d genuinely like to know how it performs in different market conditions and what can be improved.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
Honest feedback then: there's nothing here to react to yet. A trial isn't a description, and "a specific set of rules and conditions" could be literally anything.

Say what it trades, what the entry condition is, roughly how long a position stays open, and what it does during a losing streak. The prop firm people will tell you very fast whether that survives a daily drawdown rule, but only if they can see it first.

replies.author: Silent_Mango_4703
replies.body: Quan understood but we create this based on daily loss and it was working from htf to ltf .it out stop orders

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: got it. with a daily loss limit the thing I'd check is what happens to the ltf entries still open when the limit trips, since that's usually where the htf and ltf halves disagree.

replies.author: Silent_Mango_4703
replies.body:
Fair point. To clarify, this isn’t just a generic trial with undefined rules. Falcon is built with specific prop-firm settings, including the account size, daily drawdown, max drawdown, risk parameters, and trading conditions.
It also has defined entry/exit rules and risk management rather than simply giving trade signals. We have 7 months of tracked results under these settings.
I’ll share the actual rules, trade examples, and how it behaves during losing streaks so you can judge it based on the data rather than the description. Appreciate the feedback.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: Seven months tracked is worth reading. The first number I'd want is the worst losing streak in account percent, and the second is whether any rule changed inside those seven months, because that turns it into two shorter records.

comments.author: Nearby_Cranberry_443
comments.body: If it’s NQ I have seven years of tick data that I could back tested on just send me a DM.

comments.author: LaysWellWithOthers
comments.body:
7 day trial against something with no performance metrics? 

Have you actually back / forward tested this?

comments.author: Silent_Mango_4703
comments.body: Yeah bro we have 7 months track

comments.body: Guys dm me for the 7 days plan
